Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.

We confirm a binding volume of 6000 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Another bidder offers EUR 16.00 per unit for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).
Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is on file (cost:part:SH-220).
We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-J1@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 13.42 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, delivery EXW, for our full demand of 6000 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery EXW.
To be fully transparent with you:
We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.
We appreciate the firm volume commitment of 6000 units per year, which allows us to optimize our production planning.
While we acknowledge the competitive situation and your feedback on our delivery record, we must maintain our payment terms at 45 days net.
Reflecting the confirmed volume, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €15.20 per unit with a 42-day lead time.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €15.20 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
